connector.name: Produktly
connector.registryDescription: Connect your AI assistant to Produktly. Read changelogs, feedback responses, and roadmap items.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.produktly.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.produktly, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with your Produktly private key (e.g. 'Bearer pk_...'). Find it in Settings > Private Keys.
